svg.text: t2: c.1900 plans on 1840s OS sheets
Not on the page yet (open tasks): arrowhead markers (308); the reworked fit tool that opens on the works with the drawing already placed (307). Finder and Amazon data never leave the Mac.
Every site opens on the aerial photograph with its first drawing in ink; ground, ink/paper and opacity are per-viewer (localStorage). Nudges are saved on the server for everyone.
